transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: hello there

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — how is your eye doing since your surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Fine, thanks.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Glad to hear that. Is your eye currently red?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, there's no eye redness.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Okay. Is your eye currently painful?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I don't have any eye pain.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Has your vision improved as you expected since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I've noticed some mild blurry vision since the surgery, which has been a concern for me. Can you tell me if this is normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Thanks for letting me know. I’ve made a note to go into that. Would you mind if I first ask a few details about the blurriness, then come back to your question?

Are you having trouble seeing clearly at a distance, up close, or both?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I'm having some trouble seeing clearly at a distance.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Is your distance vision affected when watching TV?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, my distance vision is mildly blurry when watching TV.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Is your close-up vision affected while reading?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, my close-up vision is not affected when reading.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. When did you first notice the blurriness?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I first noticed the mild blurry vision after the surgery.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Has the blurriness been getting better or worse since then?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: The blurriness has remained about the same since then.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Would you say the blurriness is slightly hazy, or completely blurred?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I would say the blurriness is slightly hazy.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Is the blurriness only when you are wearing your old glasses?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, the blurriness is present even without my old glasses.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Thanks. You mentioned mild blurry vision, and I’m going to summarize what I’ve noted so far:

- Overall eye recovery: doing fine since surgery
- Eye redness: no redness
- Eye pain: no pain
- Blurry vision: mild, mainly at a distance while watching TV; close-up reading is not affected
- Onset: noticed after surgery
- Change over time: about the same
- Severity: slightly hazy
- Old glasses: blurriness is present even without them

Is that summary correct?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, that summary is correct.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks.

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent explicitly asked the top-level question for eye redness and did not bundle it with other questions. The patient answered the question directly.
